decisions.reason: Real data breach: 3,100 customer records (names, vehicle details, inspection reports, pricing) stolen and sold to competitor for 1,000 INR/lead. FIR filed, five suspects named. Specific commercial loss estimate of 5.70 crore INR.

Palo Alto Unit 42 documentation of AI-powered attack automation: threat actor used frontier LLMs and agentic frameworks to breach enterprise, harvest root creds, hijack cloud AI infra in under 10 hours. 50+ MITRE ATT&CK techniques, parallel LLM calls, Markdown context sharing between agents. Substantive research on emerging attack paradigm.

Critical CVE-2026-6471 (PostGREShell): 12-year-old PostgreSQL flaw allowing backup/replication accounts to execute arbitrary code via malicious logical replication plugin. Affects all versions back to 9.4 (2014). Discovered by Cyera Research, patched August 22, 2026. High-impact vulnerability in widely-used database.
